blocks.en: To: the President of Seoul National University
Application Form for Credit Recognition Between Programs

english:
Graduate students who want credits they earned at the same graduate school (Seoul National University) before their admission to SNU to be recognized.
※ For smooth academic administration, please apply in your first semester after admission.

A. Period: until 21 Sep 2026 (Mon), 5 p.m. (오후 5시)
B. Submit the application documents to the staff member in charge at the Department Administrative Office (학부행정실) (Building 301, Room 319).
C. Application documents: see the attached file (Attachment 01, 붙임01)
※ Please submit the application form together with your personal transcript (mark the courses you are applying for).
※ Your previous student ID number and department information must be linked in the system. For this reason, first submit the paper application form. After the university headquarters (본부) has processed it, complete the online system application by following the separate instructions you will receive.

A. You may apply for credit recognition only for course credits earned in a master's or doctoral program in the same or a similar major at the same graduate school (Seoul National University) before your admission to a master's or doctoral program at SNU,
(continued from above) that is, only for course credits.
B. Credits that can be recognized

* This applies only if, before admission to the doctoral program, you completed the coursework (수료, completion of required coursework without the degree) of an Integrated Master's-Doctoral program in the same or a similar department or major at SNU.
- Please refer to the attached file.
- Contact: Department Administrative Office (학부행정실) (Building 301, Room 319) / 박한수 (Park Han-su) / hansoopark@snu.ac.kr
